confirmContent: AI assistant requests to execute: {operation}. Allow?
replaceContentConfirm: Will overwrite entire content with {count} characters. Confirm?

desc.exportData: Open the current list export dialog
desc.clearSearch: Clear all search conditions and reload
desc.readVisibleRows: Read the currently visible table rows on this page
desc.nextPage: Go to the next page of the current list
desc.readRowDetail: Read the current list row detail by record id
desc.prevPage: Go to the previous page of the current list
desc.goToPage: Jump to a specific page number
desc.setPageSize: Change the number of rows shown per page
desc.createRecord: Open create form with optional pre-filled fields. User must confirm submit.
desc.editRecord: Open edit form for a record, optionally override specific fields. User must confirm submit.
desc.deleteRecord: Delete a record by ID. Requires user confirmation.
desc.navigateToDetail: Navigate to the record detail page
desc.viewRecycleBin: Open the recycle bin to view deleted records
desc.getFormState: Get the current form state: open/closed, field values, dirty fields, validation errors. Call after opening a form.
desc.fillForm: Fill form fields with provided values. Form must be open first. Supports all field types.
desc.validateForm: Trigger form validation and return errors.
desc.submitForm: Validate and submit the currently open form. The form must be filled first.

msg.availableMenusListed: Read {count} accessible menus in the current endpoint
msg.screenshotCaptured: Captured the current page screenshot and attached it to this turn
msg.screenshotFailed: Page screenshot failed. Continue with text page context for now or retry later
msg.visibleRowsRead: Read {count} visible row(s) from the current page
msg.formNotOpen: Form is not open. Use create_record or edit_record first.
msg.formAlreadyOpen: Form is already open. Continue with get_form_state, fill_form, or submit_form.
msg.noValidFields: No valid fields to fill. Known fields: {fields}
msg.editFormOpened: Edit form opened for id={id}, pre-filled: {fields}. Please review and submit.
msg.createFormOpened: Create form opened with pre-filled: {fields}. Please review and submit.
msg.createFormOpenedEmpty: Create form opened. Please fill in and submit.
msg.idRequired: Please provide record id for editing
msg.navigatedToPending: Navigated to {path}, but the destination page is still initializing
msg.operationNotRegistered: Operation '{op}' is not registered on page '{page}'
msg.pageKeyMismatch: Page operation target mismatch: requested {requested}, active page is {active}
msg.opNotFound: Operation "{op}" not found on page "{page}". Available: {available}
msg.recordNotFoundInList: Record id={id} not found in current list. Try refreshing first.
msg.dateRangeRequired: Please provide both start_date and end_date
msg.invalidDateRange: Invalid date range. Use YYYY-MM-DD and ensure start_date is not after end_date
msg.pageOutOfRange: Page {page} is out of range. Valid range: {min}-{max}
msg.menuTargetAmbiguous: "{target}" matches multiple menus. Please be more specific.
msg.menuPermissionDenied: You do not have access to the target menu: {path}
msg.menuNavigationBlocked: Navigation to {path} was blocked or did not complete
msg.optionsLoadTimeout: Loading remote options for {field} timed out. Open the form first or retry later.
